units.source_text: 妻子以为我这样子是因为生活无忧，从而放松了对自己的要求，

en.t: My wife thought I was like this because I had no worries about making a living, and had therefore grown lax in my demands on myself,

units.source_text: 妻家有些财产，足以维持她们母女俩的生活开销，

en.t: her family had some property, enough to support the living expenses of mother and daughter,

units.source_text: 而我的境况也是不用出去工作亦可度日，所以妻子这么想也很自然。

en.t: and my own circumstances were such that I could get by without going out to work, so it was only natural that my wife should think so.

units.source_text: 虽说我也不无被骄纵之感，但是，

en.t: Although I cannot say I was entirely free from the feeling of having been spoiled,

units.source_text: 我不做事的主要原因根本不在这里。

en.t: the main reason I did no work was not there at all.

units.source_text: 当初受到叔叔的欺骗后，我深切感到人是不可信赖的，

en.t: After I was deceived by my uncle at the beginning, I felt deeply that people could not be trusted,

units.source_text: 但正因为认为别人是恶的，才觉得自己还是清醒的。

en.t: but precisely because I believed others were evil, I felt that I myself was still clear-headed.

units.source_text: 我总是怀有一种信念，不管世人如何，本人必定要洁身自好。

en.t: I always held a conviction that, whatever the world might be like, I myself must keep my own integrity unstained.

units.source_text: 但是当我意识到，这种信念已由于K的自杀而幻灭，

en.t: But when I realized that this conviction had been shattered by K's suicide,

units.source_text: 自己也和叔叔是一样的人时，我突然感到困惑了。

en.t: and that I myself was the same kind of person as my uncle, I suddenly felt bewildered.

units.source_text: 一向厌恶别人的我，对自己也厌恶起来，从而陷入了绝望。

en.t: Having always detested other people, I came to detest myself as well, and thus fell into despair.
